articles.title: Ananth Technologies supplies 46 packages for GSLV-F18
articles.summary: Hyderabad-based Ananth Technologies Private Limited (ATL), a prominent space systems company, has supplied 46 flight hardware packages for the GSLV-F18 launch vehicle. Additionally, they provided nine crucial systems for an unnamed project (likely related to India's space program). This demonstrates ATL's significant contribution to advancing India's national space missions and technological self-reliance.

articles.title: Isro's GSLV successfully places NVS-03 satellite into 'designated' orbit
articles.summary: India's indigenous NavIC regional navigation system was restored to its minimum operational configuration of four satellites following ISRO's successful launch of a new navigation satellite. This achievement ensures India's strategic autonomy in navigation, reducing reliance on foreign GPS systems. It bolsters capabilities for defence, civilian, and other critical national applications, marking a significant step towards self-reliance.
